exposure: geographical area of delivery (Southern vs. Northern Italy)
Geographical area of delivery (Northern vs. Southern Italy)
cohort: Women aged 15-50 years with a diagnosis of PAS between September 2014 and August 2016 in Italy
finding: The prevalence of PAS was 0.84/1000, and antenatal suspicion of PAS was associated with improved maternal outcomes, including lower blood transfusion and hemorrhage rates.
